arguments.summary: Company-data pass: latest normalized SEC facts show positive reported operating income and operating cash flow for ANET, MU, META and NVDA, but fiscal-period lengths differ and no prior-period comparatives/guidance were retrieved here, limiting a directional operating-trajectory conclusion. QQQ's dated sponsor holdings show material overlap with NVDA, MU and META, while ANET is absent from the supplied table.

claims.text: ANET's latest normalized 10-Q facts for the six months ended 2026-06-30 report revenue of $5.7447bn, operating income of $2.5358bn, net income of $2.2358bn, operating cash flow of $2.7765bn and capex of $84.2m; the supplied derived operating margin is 44.14%.

MU's latest normalized 10-Q facts for the nine months ended 2026-05-28 report revenue of $78.959bn, operating income of $55.589bn, net income of $47.268bn, operating cash flow of $45.702bn and capex of $19.602bn; the supplied derived operating margin is 70.40%.

META's latest normalized 10-Q facts for the six months ended 2026-06-30 report revenue of $117.111bn, operating income of $41.647bn, net income of $42.621bn, operating cash flow of $64.088bn and capex of $49.113bn; reported long-term debt was $83.664bn at period end.

NVDA's latest normalized 10-Q facts for the six months ended 2026-07-26 report revenue of $177.837bn, operating income of $117.270bn, net income of $118.010bn and operating cash flow of $74.421bn; supplied derived operating margin is 65.94%. The August 26 8-K identifies the period as fiscal-2027 second-quarter results.

The reported positive operating cash flows across all four issuers support near-term operating liquidity, but META's large reported capex and MU's material capex mean cash-generation interpretation should account for reinvestment rather than income alone.

QQQ's sponsor profile (fund characteristics as of 2026-08-31) reported 103 holdings, 0.18% expense ratio and aggregate P/E of 30.08. The supplied holdings table dated 2026-09-12 is flagged stale and assigns NVDA 8.45%, MU 4.85% and META 3.07%; its top 10 represented 47.17% and reported holdings weight was 100.05%. ANET is not listed in that supplied holdings table.

QQQ therefore has dated direct look-through overlap with NVDA, MU and META; performance or company-specific news in those names can affect QQQ, subject to the stale composition and unknown current weights. The provided table does not support treating ANET as a QQQ holding.

gaps.description: No prior-period comparatives, segment/customer concentration, inventories, guidance, or earnings-release exhibits were reviewed in this pass; this prevents a source-supported conclusion on acceleration/deceleration and specific 21/63-session company catalysts for each issuer.
No observed market multiples or supported earnings estimates were supplied; company valuation scenarios cannot be grounded in current valuation inputs.
QQQ holdings are dated 2026-09-12 and flagged stale; current composition/weights and historical composition are unknown.

assumptions: Reported SEC normalized fields are used as issuer-specific historical facts, not forecasts; ANET/META/NVDA figures cover six months while MU figures cover nine months.
QQQ sponsor aggregate P/E is an ETF characteristic and is not applied as corporate EPS or a company valuation multiple.
The 21/63-session relevance is conditional on subsequent earnings, guidance, spending and demand information not retrieved in this pass.
arguments.counter_thesis: High reported margins and operating cash generation alone do not establish forward growth, durability, or valuation support. Capex intensity (notably META and MU) and missing guidance/comparative data could make currently favorable historical financials uninformative for the stated horizon.

review_conditions.description: Review the next issuer earnings releases/10-Qs for period-over-period revenue, margin, operating-cash-flow, capex, customer/segment concentration and formal outlook before adopting a 21/63-session catalyst thesis.
Refresh QQQ sponsor holdings before relying on overlap or concentration, because the supplied 2026-09-12 holdings table is flagged stale.

shared_exposures.mechanism: Dated QQQ look-through includes NVDA, MU and META; issuer-specific earnings or valuation changes may transmit into the fund through those weights.
shared_exposures.qualification: Composition is dated 2026-09-12 and flagged stale; the holding table reports no ANET position and current weights are unknown.
